mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, DUE_AT, READ_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{campaignId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{dueAt}, 'N', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y' WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId} AND NOTIFICATION_TYPE = #{type}
